```{r score ALES}
# Code script to score the Adverse Life Experiences Scale - Hawes et al. (2021)
# https://doi.org/10.1037/amp0000760
# Adapted from ABCD scoring functions: https://github.com/nbdc-datahub/ABCDscores/blob/main/R/scores_mh.R
# Scoring instructions: We created five summary scores, adapted from scoring from the ABCD study of this scale. Details can be found in the description of each of these summary variables in the corresponding JSON file.
  # ales_frequency corresponds to the sum of 'yes' responses to whether an event occured in item-level responses
  # ales_severity_sum corresponds to the sum of responses to items asking how much the event affected the participant
  # ales_severity_mean corresponds to the mean of responses to items asking how much the event affected the participant
  # ales_good_count corresponds to the sum of 'mostly good' responses to items asking whether the event was a good or bad experience
  # ales_bad_count corresponds to the sum of 'mostly bad' responses to items asking whether the event was a good or bad experience

# Load required packages 
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
ALES <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/ales.tsv")




event_vars <- paste0("ales_", 1:25)

sev_event_vars <- c(paste0("ales_", 1:11),  paste0("ales_", 12:25))
sev_vars       <- c(paste0("ales_", 1:11, "_1"), paste0("ales_", 12:25, "_2"))

exp_event_vars <- paste0("ales_", 12:25)
exp_vars       <- paste0("ales_", 12:25, "_1")  # 1=good, 2=bad

ALES_scored <- ALES %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # 1) Total endorsed events; if ANY event item is NA -> NA
    ales_frequency = if (any(is.na(c_across(all_of(event_vars))))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(c_across(all_of(event_vars)))
    },

    # helper flags for severity validity
    .sev_missing_when_endorsed = {
      ev  <- c_across(all_of(sev_event_vars))
      sev <- c_across(all_of(sev_vars))
      any((ev == 1) & is.na(sev), na.rm = TRUE)   # <-- KEY FIX
    },
    .n_endorsed_for_sev = {
      ev <- c_across(all_of(sev_event_vars))
      sum(ev == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    # 2) Severity sum; NA if any severity is NA where event==1
    ales_severity_sum = if (.sev_missing_when_endorsed) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      ev  <- c_across(all_of(sev_event_vars))
      sev <- c_across(all_of(sev_vars))
      sum(sev[ev == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    # 3) Severity mean; same NA rule; NA if no endorsed events
    ales_severity_mean = if (.sev_missing_when_endorsed || .n_endorsed_for_sev == 0) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      ev  <- c_across(all_of(sev_event_vars))
      sev <- c_across(all_of(sev_vars))
      mean(sev[ev == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    # helper flag for experience validity
    .exp_missing_when_endorsed = {
      ev  <- c_across(all_of(exp_event_vars))
      exp <- c_across(all_of(exp_vars))
      any((ev == 1) & is.na(exp), na.rm = TRUE)   # <-- KEY FIX
    },

    # 4) Count good events; NA if any exp is NA where event==1
    ales_good_count = if (.exp_missing_when_endorsed) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      ev  <- c_across(all_of(exp_event_vars))
      exp <- c_across(all_of(exp_vars))
      sum(exp[ev == 1] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    # 5) Count bad events; same NA rule
    ales_bad_count = if (.exp_missing_when_endorsed) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      ev  <- c_across(all_of(exp_event_vars))
      exp <- c_across(all_of(exp_vars))
      sum(exp[ev == 1] == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-.sev_missing_when_endorsed, -.n_endorsed_for_sev, -.exp_missing_when_endorsed)

write_tsv(ALES_scored,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/ales.tsv", na = "n/a")
```

``` {r ALES distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

ALES %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ales_frequency)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "ALES frequency (sum of affirmed events)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of ALES frequency scores")

ALES %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ales_good_bad)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "ALES good vs bad (sum)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of ALES good/bad scores")

ALES %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ales_effect)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "ALES effect (sum)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of ALES effect scores")

```
